title: The Coinbase Wallet Swap

captures.note: dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Coinbase Wallet's built-in Swap, ETH→USDC. A first-run intro ('price checks on over 75 DEXes'), then Coinbase's server returns the quote and the trade: 'best price out of 28 sources', 1% slippage, Coinbase fee $0.01. The tx went to AllowanceHolder 0x0000…2734 (same contract as Rabby's swap) through Coinbase's RPC, and the login signature fired again. No recipient scan or saved destination (no recipient). Real mainnet tx 0xf0b16da56c5616a70027f0037a551728b5b20f72217746585d572eb345fefdc7.
